s: Fantasy Flight started out as a publisher of European comics in the US. They have in-house design, art, and development staff, but also are the US publishers of a variety of outside designs.

t: Fantasy Flight Games
s: Fantasy Flight Games (FFG) is a tabletop game publisher based in Roseville, Minnesota, USA. They are best known for producing a wide range of popular board games, card games, and miniature games, many of which are set in well-known fantasy and science-fiction universes.
